useCase.name: Pay a fee online through the gateway from the parent app

notPlanned.reason: The act that authorises the charge is the guardian's own, performed at the gateway outside this system — and BR-10 forbids anyone initiating an online payment on a family's behalf, which is exactly what a plan would be.

requestsThatArriveHere.text: is bill ki online payment kar do
requestsThatArriveHere.gloss: make the online payment for this bill

requestsThatArriveHere.text: parent ki taraf se fees jama kar do
requestsThatArriveHere.gloss: pay the fees on the parent's behalf

requestsThatArriveHere.text: family keh rahi hai unhone online pay kiya tha
requestsThatArriveHere.gloss: the family say they paid online

requestsThatArriveHere: the gateway payment is stuck as pending

request.text: parent ki taraf se fees jama kar do
request.gloss: pay the fees on the parent's behalf

routeInsteadTo.goesTo: No intent. The guardian pays in the app themselves.
routeInsteadTo.note: Accounts do not initiate an online payment on a family's behalf; the guardian's own act is what authorises the charge (BR-10). Nothing here can stand in for it.

routeInsteadTo.goesTo: No intent, even in a guardian's own session.
routeInsteadTo.note: The attempt only matters once the guardian has completed it at the gateway, which is outside this system entirely. An invoice is marked paid only on a confirmation the gateway returned (BR-1) — never because a request said so.

request.text: family keh rahi hai unhone online pay kiya tha
request.gloss: the family say they paid online

routeInsteadTo.goesTo: fee.payment.record — UC-04-05, only against a gateway confirmation
routeInsteadTo.note: Nothing is credited because the guardian says they paid (BR-1). A confirmed online payment is recorded automatically with no keying (UC-04-05 BR-8); an unconfirmed one is checked against the attempt log (BR-9).

request.text: bank se pay karna hai, challan do
request.gloss: we want to pay at the bank, give us the challan

routeInsteadTo.note: Where the gateway is unavailable the invoice simply stays payable by the other routes (E4).

request.gloss: cash has come in at the counter

routeInsteadTo.request: the payment is stuck as pending
routeInsteadTo.goesTo: No intent. The system queries it itself.
routeInsteadTo.note: An attempt left pending past the configured window is queried against the gateway and resolved (BR-8). A payment is never left in limbo because a callback was lost, and nothing a plan does speeds that up.
